subject: Closing playbook: signer rotations, blackout windows, and Day 1 ramp slot
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <claire@retailco.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & final signoff windows for RetailCo pilot

Claire —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation I attached an updated Mutual Action Plan (RWinf-MAP-v3.pdf) that compresses the eval milestones and highlights Final Acceptance signoff tasks. Two quick things I want to call out up front:

- Final exec signoff: we need a named approver and a preferred 2-hour window for DocuSign routing between June 7–11.
- Day 1 ramp slot: we recommend launching on the first Monday after signature; if we sign by 11 Jun we can target Monday 15 Jun for an extended onboarding ramp.

High-level MAP items (see attached for full checklist):
1) Security questionnaire and audit evidence — procurement asked for SOC 2 evidence (we included links).
2) Pilot acceptance tests — three eval prompts and SLA checks; failure modes + rollback steps documented.
3) Billing & procurement — PO / billing contact + Net 30 preferred.
4) Execution & start date — signer availability matrix and cs handoff plan.

Next steps from our side: Kimberly is ready to triage any legal redlines; Camila will coordinate the implementation kickoff. Can you share the name and title of the internal approver and any blackout dates for your leadership team next week?

Attaching: RWinf-MAP-v3.pdf, signature-availability-grid.xlsx

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
From: Claire Park <claire@retailco.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@retailco.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 08:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & final signoff windows for RetailCo pilot

Sean —

Appreciate the clean MAP. A couple of constraints from procurement and legal:
- Procurement needs our SOC 2 scoping confirmation and a stub of the PO (we can do Net 30 but need the PO by signing).
- Legal will likely ask for a minor data retention clause tweak; I’ll share the in-house note.

Approver: Clara Higgins, SVP Product — she typically signs but has a recurring offsite on Tue/Thu afternoons next two weeks (blackout). Best 2-hour window is Mon/Wed 10:00–12:00 PT.

Can you send a DocuSign link that supports a multi-signer routing (Clara -> Procurement)? Also include the short checklist our security team can use to validate the SOC 2 excerpts.

Thanks —
Claire
Claire Park
Director, Product Ops — RetailCo
claire@retailco.com

Subject: Re: Draft MAP & final signoff windows for RetailCo pilot — legal tweaks

Team / Claire —

I reviewed the attached MAP and the two clauses I expect redlines on: data retention window (we propose 90 days for ephemeral logs, 1 year for aggregated telemetry) and liability cap language that references usage volumes. Both are negotiable; to keep timeline tight I suggest:

- We prepare a tracked-change DocuSign-ready exhibit with the two proposed edits.
- Sean to confirm the exec signoff slot (Claire suggested Mon/Wed 10–12 PT).
- If Clara needs a paper copy, we can prepare a PDF outside of DocuSign the same day.

Camila — I'll need the onboarding contact and an estimated weekly token volume so legal can size the liability cap and billing items.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Draft MAP & final signoff windows for RetailCo pilot — proposed runbook and final sync

Claire / team —

Following up with a concise runbook for the final week (attached as a one-pager inside RWinf-MAP-v3.pdf):

Action items (target dates):
- Tue, 2 Jun: Legal exhibits finalized (Kimberly) — tracked changes saved as Exhibit A.
- Wed, 3 Jun: Procurement to confirm PO stub and billing contact.
- Mon, 8 Jun: Exec signoff window (10:00–12:00 PT) reserved for Clara — we’ll route DocuSign 9:30am PT to allow time for review.
- Tue, 9 Jun: DocuSign completes; Redwood issues invoice and CS sends onboarding calendar invite.
- Mon, 15 Jun: Day 1 ramp (full pilot kickoff).

Please note a couple of key constraints we built in:
- Blackout/rotations: If Clara's offsite conflicts, we have alternate approver listed (Procurement lead) but that adds an extra signer in the routing and could push Day 1 by one week.
- Escrow: procurement asked about an escrow for interim data; Kimberly and I agreed a scoped escrow addendum would take ~3 business days to finalize — we prefer to avoid that if possible to keep the 15 June target.

DocuSign link (test): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123-xyz
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/HC-98765

Attachments: RWinf-MAP-v3.pdf (one-pager runbook), signature-availability-grid.xlsx

Can you confirm: 1) Clara is confirmed for Mon 8 Jun 10:00–12:00 PT; 2) Procurement can supply a PO stub by Wed 3 Jun? If yes we lock DocuSign routing next week.

—Sean
From: Claire Park <claire@retailco.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@retailco.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & final signoff windows for RetailCo pilot — confirmation

Sean / Kimberly —

Confirmed: Clara is available Mon, 8 Jun 10:00–12:00 PT and Procurement will deliver a PO stub by Wed, 3 Jun. Legal reviewed your proposed retention language and is okay to proceed with Kimberly's Exhibit A as drafted (minor wording tweak accepted).

Procurement will be the second signer in routing (Clara -> Procurement). Please route DocuSign at 9:30am PT on Mon 8 Jun. We will sign the DocuSign envelope that morning; expect a completed envelope by lunch.

Final note: please loop CS for Day 1 readiness; Camila, can you confirm the onboarding calendar and the extended 2-week ramp plan?

Thanks —
Claire
